title: SubstackDrafterInput
description: Input schema for the substack-drafter Yeshie skill

storyPath.description: Absolute path to the staged markdown story file

substackEmail.description: Substack account email. If omitted, reads from SUBSTACK_EMAIL env or ~/.config/substack-drafter/creds.json

substackPassword.description: Substack account password. If omitted, reads from SUBSTACK_PASSWORD env or ~/.config/substack-drafter/creds.json

draftOnly.description: Must be true. Publish is not supported.
